title: The Monday Brief
lede: Three decisions need you and main is red in the web app. Everything else was built, reviewed and shipped while you slept.
cadence: Next brief at 13:00. Until then you hear only about what cannot wait.

topics.name: Web app
topics.progress: This week: the shipment filters, the new sign-in and the dependency updates.

decisions.title: Release the fix for exports that time out
decisions.context: Exports fail for the 14 largest accounts. The fix passed its tests, a fresh review and a run on staging. Rolling back takes 2 minutes.
decisions.doneNote: Approved. The Release lane rolls out at 22:00 and watches for 30 minutes.

decisions.title: Run the tax-rate migration on the production database
decisions.context: It adds 2 columns and fills 48,000 invoices. A backup comes first. The dry run on a copy took 41 seconds.
decisions.doneNote: Approved. The migration runs tonight at 23:00, after the backup.

decisions.title: Choose the new sign-in: passkeys or a link by email
decisions.context: Both are built behind a switch and passed QA. Passkeys take 2 screens, the email link takes 4. The lane suggests passkeys.
decisions.doneNote: Approved. Passkeys go to staging today, with the email link as the fallback.

burns.title: Main is red in the web app
burns.detail: The nightly run fails at sign-in since the dependency update at 03:05. Builder tried 3 fixes and stopped at its limit.

overnight.text: API released the rate-limit fix after its review. The check on production passed.
Billing merged the invoice rounding fix after 2 review rounds.
Web app updated 6 dependencies and held 1 back because its tests failed.
Infra renewed the staging certificate, 12 days before it ran out.
Mobile deleted 4 branches that were already merged.

drafts.detail: 2 are ready and wait for you, 2 are in review, and 1 merges by itself at 09:00 because it only changes docs.
